lines.text: I will praise God’s name in song
And this will please the LORD more than an ox,
more than a bull with horns and hooves.
The humble will see and rejoice.
You who seek God, let your hearts be revived!
For the LORD listens to the needy
and does not despise His captive people.
Let heaven and earth praise Him,
the seas and everything that moves in them.
and rebuild the cities of Judah,
that they may dwell there and possess it.
The descendants of His servants will inherit it,
and those who love His name will settle in it.

pictures.scene: Judith Leyster, De serenade - a player singing out with his head thrown back and his instrument lifted, I will praise God's name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving
pictures.name: pd_leyster_de_serenade

pictures.scene: Constant Troyon, Ossen op weg naar het ploegland - the yoked oxen driven up to the field in the morning light, this will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with horns and hooves
pictures.name: pd_troyon_ossen_op_weg_naar_het_ploegland

pictures.scene: Ludwig Knaus, De poezenmoeder - a poor old woman's face lit up with delight over the kittens in her lap, the humble will see and rejoice, let your hearts be revived
pictures.name: pd_knaus_de_poezenmoeder

pictures.scene: Valery Jacobi, Rustplaats van de gevangenen - exiles halted by the roadside milepost, women in headcloths, a sleeping child and an old man with his face covered, the LORD listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people
pictures.name: pd_jacobi_rustplaats_van_de_gevangenen

pictures.scene: Hendrick Dubbels, Kalme zee - a Dutch vessel mirrored in glassy water under an immense pale sky, let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything that moves in them
pictures.name: pd_dubbels_kalme_zee

pictures.scene: Johannes Christiaan Karel Klinkenberg, Het Binnenhof - workmen's benches and trestles set up in the sunlit arcade of the old court, God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah
pictures.name: pd_klinkenberg_het_binnenhof

pictures.scene: Franz von Defregger, Sommerfrische - a mother seated at her own doorway with a small girl standing by and a toddler on the ground beside her, that they may dwell there and possess it, the descendants of His servants will inherit it
pictures.name: pd_defregger_sommerfrische

pictures.scene: Johannes Warnardus Bilders, Landschap met boerenwoning - a thatched cottage among the oaks with a woman carrying her basket home along the sandy track, those who love His name will settle in it
pictures.name: pd_bilders_landschap_met_boerenwoning
